title: EmoTrace-Bench: Diagnosing Emotional Expression in Text-to-Video Generation through Controlled Cues and Intensity
title_zh: EmoTrace-Bench：通过受控提示词与强度分析文本到视频生成中的情感表达诊断

paragraphs.en: Text-to-video (T2V) models are increasingly used to generate videos with targeted emotional expressions, yet existing evaluation methods mainly rely on holistic video–text alignment and provide limited insight into whether failures arise from target-emotion expression, intensity control, or specific affective cues. We introduce EmoTrace-Bench, a fine-grained diagnostic benchmark that controls emotion intensity and selected affective cues in prompts and evaluates generated videos at multiple levels. EmoTrace-Bench contains 448 controlled prompts covering eight emotions, two intensity levels, and diverse cue conditions. Using 12 T2V models, we generate 5,376 videos and evaluate target-emotion presence, perceived intensity, and ten audiovisual dimensions of emotional expression with an automated evaluator calibrated and validated against human annotations on a subset of the data. Results reveal substantial differences across models and prompt designs. Prompts that explicitly describe a character’s emotional reaction are followed more reliably than prompts that describe only events or scenes, whereas adding more affective cues or using more explicit cinematic audiovisual language does not consistently improve emotional generation. These results illustrate how aggregate alignment scores may overlook localized differences in target-emotion expression, intensity control, and cue realization. EmoTrace-Bench provides a traceable and interpretable framework for diagnosing emotional video generation without modifying existing generation pipelines, and we release the prompts and the automated evaluation rules.

paragraphs.en: Generating videos with explicit emotional expression is an important capability for controllable content generation in text-to-video (T2V) models. For controllable emotion generation, the key question is not only whether a video presents the target emotion, but also whether it follows the prompt’s requirements regarding the emotion category, emotion intensity, and specific expressive cues. Emotion generation in T2V is therefore not a single-dimensional problem; rather, it simultaneously involves multiple interrelated yet distinguishable capabilities, including emotion category, emotion intensity, and specific emotional cues.
paragraphs.zh: 生成具有明确情感表情的视频，是文本到视频（T2V）模型中实现可控内容生成的重要能力。 在可控情感生成方面，关键问题不仅在于视频是否呈现了目标情感，还在于其是否符合提示词对情感类别、情感强度及具体表达线索的要求。 因此，T2V 中的情感生成并非一个单一维度的问题；相反，它同时涉及多个相互关联但可区分的能力，包括情感类别、情感强度以及具体的情感线索。

paragraphs.en: However, existing T2V evaluations have difficulty effectively distinguishing these capabilities. Existing multidimensional video generation benchmarks mainly focus on semantic consistency, visual quality, motion performance, and compositional relationships, and they generally lack explicit modeling of emotional expression ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Han et al., 2025 ) . The few works oriented toward emotion generation also mostly use aggregate scores to measure the overall match between generated videos and emotion prompts ( Qiu et al., 2026 ) . Although these metrics can indicate whether a video aligns with its prompt overall, they provide limited insight into the specific causes of mismatches and may collapse qualitatively different generation errors into similar aggregate scores, thereby obscuring meaningful differences in models’ ability to follow fine-grained emotional instructions. As a result, such evaluations cannot fully characterize a model’s controllability over emotion category, intensity, and mode of expression in practical content creation.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，现有的 T2V 评估方法难以有效区分这些能力。 现有的多维视频生成基准主要关注语义一致性、视觉质量、运动表现和构图关系，但通常缺乏对情感表达的明确建模（Huang et al., 2024；Huang et al., 2026；Zheng et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2024；Han et al., 2025）。 少数面向情感生成的研究也大多使用综合评分来衡量生成视频与情感提示之间的整体匹配度（Qiu et al., 2026）。 尽管这些指标能够表明视频是否与提示在整体上保持一致，但它们对不匹配的具体原因仅提供有限洞察，并可能将性质不同的生成错误归为相似的综合评分，从而掩盖模型在执行精细情感指令能力上的显著差异。 因此，此类评估无法全面反映模型在实际内容创作中对情感类别、强度和表达方式的控制能力。

paragraphs.en: Adding more output-side metrics alone is insufficient, because confounds often arise during prompt construction. Emotional prompts typically combine multiple cues, making it difficult to attribute output changes to specific factors. Differences across emotion categories can further confound intensity comparisons. Reliable diagnosis therefore requires controlled inputs as well as fine-grained outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 仅增加更多输出端的指标是不够的，因为在提示构建过程中常常会出现混淆因素。 情感提示通常会结合多种线索，这使得将输出变化归因于特定因素变得困难。 不同情绪类别之间的差异可能会进一步干扰对强度的比较。 因此，可靠的诊断既需要受控的输入，也需要精细的输出。

paragraphs.en: We propose EmoTrace-Bench (Figure 1 ), which treats prompts as controlled experimental variables. It varies two main factors: affective cues and emotion intensity. Cue-controlled prompts change only one cue phrase while keeping the rest fixed, with additional paraphrased variants to test sensitivity to wording. Intensity-controlled prompt pairs differ only in intensity-related terms while preserving the emotion category, scene, and other content. This design enables separate analysis of emotion category, intensity, and specific cues. Figure 2 summarizes the overall pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 EmoTrace-Bench（图 1），它将提示视为受控的实验变量。 它变化两个主要因素：情感线索和情感强度。 线索受控提示仅改变一个线索短语，其余部分保持不变，并辅以额外的改写变体以测试对措辞的敏感度。 强度受控提示对仅在强度相关术语上有所不同，同时保留情感类别、场景和其他内容。 这种设计使得能够分别分析情感类别、强度和特定线索。 图 2 总结了整体流程。

paragraphs.en: At the output, we annotate target-emotion success, perceived intensity, and ten audiovisual cue dimensions. Using 448 controlled prompts, we generate 5,376 videos from 12 T2V models and collect human annotations for 1,120 videos from three of them to validate the automated evaluation. The analysis reveals that emotion-category generation and intensity control are distinct capabilities, model performance can be sensitive to cue wording, and automated evaluation agrees broadly with human judgments while small systematic differences remain on some fine-grained dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: 在输出结果中，我们标注了目标情绪的成功度、感知强度以及十个视听线索维度。 我们使用 448 个受控提示，从 12 个 T2V 模型中生成 5,376 个视频，并从其中三个模型收集 1,120 个视频的人工标注，以验证自动化评估的有效性。 分析表明，情绪类别的生成和强度的控制是两种不同的能力，模型性能可能对线索措辞较为敏感，且自动化评估结果与人工判断基本一致，但在某些精细维度上仍存在细微的系统性差异。

paragraphs.en: By controlling variables at the input and conducting fine-grained diagnosis at the output, EmoTrace-Bench decomposes emotion-generation performance that was previously mixed together in overall scores into more specific dimensions and prompt factors. At the same time, through per-video, per-attribute comparisons between human and automated evaluation, it further reveals the scope of applicability and limitations of automated evaluation across different emotional dimensions.

paragraphs.en: The main contributions of this paper are threefold:
paragraphs.zh: 本文的主要贡献有三点：

paragraphs.en: We introduce EmoTrace-Bench , a fine-grained diagnostic benchmark for emotion generation in text-to-video models. It decomposes emotion generation into three complementary levels: emotion category, emotion intensity, and ten affective cue channels, enabling localized diagnosis of generation failures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 EmoTrace-Bench，这是一个用于文本到视频模型中情绪生成的高精度诊断基准。 它将情绪生成分解为三个互补的层面：情绪类别、情绪强度以及十个情感线索通道，从而能够针对生成失败进行局部诊断。

sents.en: We introduce EmoTrace-Bench , a fine-grained diagnostic benchmark for emotion generation in text-to-video models.
sents.zh: 我们提出 EmoTrace-Bench，这是一个用于文本到视频模型中情绪生成的高精度诊断基准。

sents.en: It decomposes emotion generation into three complementary levels: emotion category, emotion intensity, and ten affective cue channels, enabling localized diagnosis of generation failures.
sents.zh: 它将情绪生成分解为三个互补的层面：情绪类别、情绪强度以及十个情感线索通道，从而能够针对生成失败进行局部诊断。

paragraphs.en: We develop a controlled prompt-construction framework that independently varies emotion intensity and affective cues under a minimal-difference design. It also includes semantically matched cue variants with different linguistic realizations, allowing us to study prompt sensitivity while reducing confounding across input factors.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种受控的提示构建框架，该框架在最小差异设计下独立变化情绪强度和情感线索。 它还包含语义匹配但语言实现不同的线索变体，使我们能够在减少输入因素间混淆的同时研究提示的敏感性。

paragraphs.en: We benchmark 12 text-to-video models on 448 controlled prompts, yielding 5,376 generated videos, and collect human annotations for 1,120 videos to validate the automated evaluation protocol. Our analysis reveals substantial differences across models in emotion-category generation, intensity control, and prompt sensitivity, while showing that aggregate automated judgments are broadly aligned with human annotations. We release the prompts and the automated evaluation rules.

paragraphs.en: T2V evaluation has evolved from overall quality assessment toward multidimensional diagnosis. VBench, VBench++, VBench-2.0, EvalCrafter, and Video-Bench evaluate visual quality, motion, temporal consistency, subject consistency, spatial relations, text alignment, and higher-level generation fidelity ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Han et al., 2025 ) . VABench and T2AV-Compass further consider audio quality and audiovisual consistency ( Hua et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2025 ) , while T2V-CompBench uses controlled prompts to evaluate compositional generation ( Sun et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: Despite this progress, these benchmarks mainly target general generation quality, semantic adherence, and compositionality. Emotional expression is rarely modeled as a structured capability with separable dimensions. Existing evaluations therefore provide limited diagnosis of whether errors arise from emotion category, intensity, or specific character, scene, and audiovisual cues.

paragraphs.en: Recent work has begun to study emotion-aware video generation. EmoVid provides a multimodal dataset for emotion-centric video understanding and generation ( Qiu et al., 2026 ) ; FG-ECVG explores fine-grained controllable emotional video generation ( Wei et al., 2025 ) ; and EmoTalker studies editable emotional expression in talking-face generation ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) . EmoWorld further disentangles atmosphere, affective semantic cues, and temporal progression, showing that video emotion contains multiple controllable components ( Wang et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究开始探索具备情绪感知能力的视频生成技术。 EmoVid 提供了一个多模态数据集，用于以情绪为核心的视频理解与生成（Qiu 等，2026）；FG-ECVG 研究了精细可控的情绪化视频生成（Wei 等，2025）；而 EmoTalker 则探讨了在说话人脸生成中可编辑的情绪表达（Zhang 等，2024）。 EmoWorld 进一步分离了氛围、情感语义线索和时间演进要素，表明视频情绪包含多个可控制的组成部分（Wang 等，2026a）。

paragraphs.en: These works mainly focus on emotional data, generation, or model-side control. Their evaluations still commonly rely on emotion-recognition accuracy, condition matching, or aggregate scores. Such metrics may assign similar scores to different failures, such as generating the correct emotion at the wrong intensity or creating an appropriate atmosphere without the requested facial or bodily expression. Thus, an overall emotion score is insufficient for diagnosing fine-grained emotional controllability.
paragraphs.zh: 这些研究主要关注情感数据、生成或模型侧的控制。 它们的评价通常仍然依赖情感识别准确率、条件匹配或综合得分。 这类指标可能会给不同的失败情况赋予相似的分数，例如以错误的强度生成正确的情感，或者在没有呈现所需面部或身体表情的情况下营造出恰当的氛围。 因此，单一的整体情感得分不足以诊断精细的情感可控性。

paragraphs.en: Emotion is conveyed through multiple channels. Psychological studies highlight the roles of facial expression, body posture, and movement ( Ekman & Friesen, 1978 ; Cohn et al., 2007 ; Coulson, 2004 ; Dael et al., 2012a ; Dael et al., 2012b ; Aviezer et al., 2012 ) , while film studies show that shot scale, motion, lighting, color, sound, and music also shape emotional perception ( Bálint et al., 2018 ; Detenber et al., 1998 ; Chion, 1994 ; Cohen, 2010 ; Bordwell et al., 2020 ) . Recent benchmarks such as Stable Cinemetrics and FilmBench evaluate structured cinematic attributes ( Chatterjee et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) , while HVEval and HUG-VIS examine human-centered appearance, action, and emotion ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 情感通过多种渠道传递。 心理学研究强调了面部表情、身体姿势和动作的作用（Ekman & Friesen, 1978；Cohn et al., 2007；Coulson, 2004；Dael et al., 2012a；Dael et al., 2012b；Aviezer et al., 2012），而电影研究则表明，镜头规模、运动、灯光、色彩、声音和音乐也会影响情感感知（Bálint et al., 2018；Detenber et al., 1998；Chion, 1994；Cohen, 2010；Bordwell et al., 2020）。 近期的基准测试，如 Stable Cinemetrics 和 FilmBench，评估了结构化的电影属性（Chatterjee et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2026b），而 HVEval 和 HUG-VIS 则检验了以人为中心的外观、动作和情感（Wu et al., 2025；Ma et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Building on these directions, EmoTrace-Bench decomposes emotion generation into emotion category, emotion intensity, and specific affective cues. It combines controlled prompts with fine-grained output evaluation to diagnose whether the target emotion is generated, whether its intensity follows the prompt, and through which character, scene, and audiovisual cues it is expressed. This moves emotion-generation evaluation from holistic matching toward traceable fine-grained diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些方向，EmoTrace-Bench将情绪生成分解为情绪类别、情绪强度以及具体的情感线索。 它将受控提示与精细的输出评估相结合，以诊断目标情绪是否被生成、其强度是否符合提示要求，以及通过哪些角色、场景和视听线索来表达。 这将情绪生成的评估从整体匹配转向可追溯的精细诊断。

paragraphs.en: Selection of Eight Emotions. EmoTrace-Bench includes eight emotions: amusement, excitement, awe, contentment, anger, fear, disgust, and sadness. The selection follows the discrete emotion set established by Mikels et al. using the International Affective Picture System (IAPS) ( Mikels et al., 2005 ) . It contains four positive and four negative emotions spanning different typical arousal levels ( Russell, 1980 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 八种情绪的选择。 EmoTrace-Bench 包含八种情绪：愉悦、兴奋、敬畏、满足、愤怒、恐惧、厌恶和悲伤。 这一选择遵循了 Mikels 等人基于国际情感图片系统（IAPS）建立的离散情绪集（Mikels et al., 2005）。 它包含四种积极情绪和四种消极情绪，涵盖了不同的典型唤醒水平（Russell, 1980）。

paragraphs.en: Three-Level Evaluation. For each generated video, the first level determines whether the target emotion is expressed. The second evaluates perceived emotion intensity as strong or weak when the target emotion is present, and as “not matched” otherwise. The third identifies which audiovisual cue dimensions support the target emotion. These levels capture whether the intended emotion is expressed, how strongly it is expressed, and through which cues.

paragraphs.en: Multidimensional Affective Cues. Emotional expression in video can arise from character behavior, environmental context, and audiovisual form. Drawing on theories of emotional expression, film form, and an external inventory of affective cues ( Smith, 2003 ) , we define ten dimensions: facial expression, bodily behavior, lighting, color, composition, visual dynamics, temporal organization, sound, scene, and event. We retain cues that can be directly observed and judged relatively independently in short videos, while excluding factors that require long-form narrative, dialogue semantics, or broader temporal context. Operational definitions and channel-specific prerequisites are provided in Appendix C (Table C.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 多维情感线索。 视频中的情感表达可能源于角色行为、环境背景以及视听形式。 基于情感表达理论、电影形式以及对情感线索的外部清单（Smith, 2003），我们定义了十个维度：面部表情、身体行为、灯光、色彩、构图、视觉动态、时间组织、声音、场景和事件。 我们保留了可以在短视频中直接观察并相对独立判断的线索，同时排除了需要长篇幅叙事、对话语义或更广泛时间背景的因素。 操作定义及各通道的具体前提条件见附录 C（表 C.1）。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark crosses 8 emotions, 2 intensity levels with 2 samples each, and 14 prompt templates, yielding 448 prompts. The templates include emotion-only prompts, individual facial, bodily, scene, and event cues, combinations of character and environmental cues, alternative linguistic realizations, facial changes, empty scenes, and prompts containing all explicitly writable cues. Eight of the ten evaluation dimensions—facial expression, bodily behavior, lighting, color, composition, visual dynamics, scene, and event—can be explicitly specified in prompts. Temporal organization and sound are evaluated only in the generated video. Each prompt records whether a cue dimension is explicitly specified or left unspecified but observable, allowing explicit instruction following to be distinguished from cues that emerge without being requested. Representative prompt conditions are shown in Figure B.1 in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试涵盖 8 种情绪、2 个强度等级（每个等级包含 2 个样本）以及 14 种提示模板，最终生成 448 条提示。 这些模板包括仅包含情绪的提示、单独的面部、身体、场景和事件线索、角色与环境线索的组合、不同的语言表达方式、面部变化、空场景，以及包含所有可明确书写的线索的提示。 十个评估维度中有八个——面部表情、身体行为、光线、色彩、构图、视觉动态、场景和事件——可以在提示中明确指定。 时间组织与声音仅在生成的视频中进行评估。 每条提示都会记录某个线索维度是明确指定的，还是虽未明确指定但可通过观察得出，从而能够区分对明确指令的遵循与无需请求即可出现的线索。 具有代表性的提示条件展示在附录 B 的图 B.1 中。

paragraphs.en: Alternative Linguistic Realizations. To examine sensitivity to prompt formulation, we construct controlled prompt pairs that express similar affective content using different linguistic realizations. These pairs preserve the target emotion, scene, and intended affective content while changing how that content is described. They therefore allow us to test whether semantically similar instructions lead to different generation outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 替代性语言实现。 为了检验提示措辞的敏感性，我们构建受控的提示对，这些提示对使用不同的语言实现来表达相似的情感内容。 这些提示对保留了目标情感、场景和预期的情感内容，同时改变了这些内容的描述方式。 因此，它们使我们能够测试语义上相似的指令是否会导致不同的生成结果。

paragraphs.en: Prompt Control and Validation. We apply three constraints to reduce unintended variation. First, strong–weak pairs share the same emotion, scene, base description, and template and differ only in preregistered intensity expressions; all 224 / 224 224/224 pairs pass character-level structural verification. Second, cue segments are reused across templates whenever possible. Of 384 reused segments, 372 are identical and 12 differ only in pronoun disambiguation; all 384 match after normalization. Third, controlled template pairs vary only the preregistered prompt factor, and all 448 prompts have unique SHA-256 hashes. These checks (Table B.4 ) establish structural consistency for controlled comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 提示词控制与验证。 我们应用三种约束条件，以减少非预期的变化。 首先，强–弱配对共享相同的情感、场景、基础描述和模板，仅在前注册强度表达上存在差异；所有 224 / 224 224/224 对均通过字符级结构验证。 其次，在可能的情况下，提示词片段会在不同模板中重复使用。 在 384 个重复使用的片段中，有 372 个完全相同，另有 12 个仅在代词消歧上存在差异；经过归一化处理后，所有 384 个片段均匹配一致。 第三，受控模板配对仅在前注册的提示词因素上存在差异，且所有 448 个提示词都具有唯一的 SHA-256 哈希值。 这些检查（表 B.4）确保了受控比较的结构一致性。

paragraphs.en: Automated evaluation and human annotation follow the same three-level decision structure and information boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化评估与人工标注遵循相同的三级决策结构和信息边界。

paragraphs.en: Shared Evaluation Protocol. Both evaluators first determine whether the target emotion is present. If present, perceived intensity is labeled as strong or weak; otherwise it is labeled “not matched.” Each of the ten affective cue dimensions is then judged independently as present or absent in support of the target emotion. Emotion and intensity are judged directly and are not inferred from cue labels.
paragraphs.zh: 共享评估协议。 两位评估者首先判断目标情绪是否存在。 如果存在，则将其感知强度标记为“强”或“弱”；否则标记为“不匹配”。随后，对十个情感线索维度逐一独立判断其是否存在，以支持目标情绪的存在。 情绪和强度是直接判断的，而非从线索标签中推断得出。

sents.zh: 共享评估协议。

sents.en: Both evaluators first determine whether the target emotion is present.
sents.zh: 两位评估者首先判断目标情绪是否存在。

sents.en: If present, perceived intensity is labeled as strong or weak; otherwise it is labeled “not matched.” Each of the ten affective cue dimensions is then judged independently as present or absent in support of the target emotion.

paragraphs.en: Both evaluators see only the generated video, including its native audio, and the name and definition of the target emotion. They do not have access to the generation prompt or other metadata. The target emotion is provided because the task evaluates whether a specified emotion is expressed. The target intensity is hidden to reduce label-following bias.

paragraphs.en: Automated Evaluation. All 5,376 videos are evaluated once using Gemini 3.1 Pro with temperature 0 under a frozen two-stage protocol: the first stage judges target emotion and perceived intensity, and the second stage judges the ten cue channels (Appendix C ). Videos are sampled at 8 fps. Auxiliary programs provide measurement summaries for visual dynamics and sound using cross-frame motion and audio features, respectively. The resulting single-run outputs are used for all 12-model benchmark results.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化评估。 所有 5,376 个视频均使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro，在温度为 0 且采用冻结的两阶段协议下进行一次评估：第一阶段判断目标情绪和感知强度，第二阶段判断十个提示通道（附录 C）。 视频以 8 fps 的帧率进行采样。 辅助程序分别通过跨帧运动和音频特征提供视觉动态与声音的测量摘要。 由此产生的单次运行输出被用于所有 12 个模型的基准测试结果。

paragraphs.en: To assess evaluator stability, we conduct two additional evaluation runs on the 896-video development set. Development-set validity results are reported as the mean over the three runs (Appendix D ). Wan-2.2, HunyuanVideo-1.5, Kandinsky-5.0-T2V-Pro, and LongCat-Video-13.6B do not provide usable native audio, so the sound dimension and Full 10D aggregate are not reported for these models.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估评估器的稳定性，我们在包含 896 个视频的验证集上进行了两次额外的评估运行。 验证集的有效性结果以三次运行的平均值呈现（附录 D）。 Wan-2.2、HunyuanVideo-1.5、Kandinsky-5.0-T2V-Pro 和 LongCat-Video-13.6B 均未提供可用的原生音频，因此这些模型没有报告声音维度和完整 10D 聚合结果。

paragraphs.en: The development set contains 896 videos from two generation models. Two senior annotators independently label all videos. Their matching labels form the first-pass consensus, while disagreements are resolved by the majority of available labels from five additional trained annotators (Appendix D ). The test set contains 224 videos from a third generation model and was not used in protocol development. Two trained annotators provide full first-pass annotations and form the initial consensus.

paragraphs.en: After the automated evaluator is frozen, senior annotators conduct a second review of both sets (Appendix D ). Reviewers see only the video and decision rules, without access to the generation prompt, model identity, target intensity, or automated outputs. Reviewed labels form the reviewed human reference, and fields without a reviewed label are excluded from analyses against it.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化评估器被锁定后，高级标注员会对两组数据（附录 D）进行第二轮审核。 审核人员仅能看到视频和决策规则，无法访问生成提示、模型身份、目标强度或自动化输出结果。 经过审核的标签构成经审核的人类参考标准，而没有经过审核标签的字段则不会被纳入与该标准的对比分析中。

paragraphs.en: Metric Computation. The joint emotion-and-intensity score is computed over all 448 videos per model. Visual 9D averages cue support over the nine non-audio channels and is available for all models; Full 10D adds the sound channel and is therefore reported only for audio-capable models (Appendix C ). Both are computed only for videos that successfully express the target emotion and should therefore be interpreted together with target-emotion accuracy. “Undecided” and “not applicable” labels are excluded from the corresponding denominators.
paragraphs.zh: 指标计算。 联合情绪与强度得分针对每个模型的全部 448 个视频进行计算。 视觉 9D 对九个非音频通道的线索支持进行平均，且适用于所有模型；完整 10D 则增加了声音通道，因此仅对具备音频能力的模型报告该指标（附录 C）。 两者均仅针对成功表达目标情绪的视频进行计算，因此应与目标情绪准确率一同解读。“未决定”和“不适用”标签不包含在相应的分母中。

sents.zh: 两者均仅针对成功表达目标情绪的视频进行计算，因此应与目标情绪准确率一同解读。“未决定”和“不适用”标签不包含在相应的分母中。

paragraphs.en: We analyze EmoTrace-Bench from three perspectives. First, we compare 12 T2V models in terms of target-emotion generation, intensity control, and cue realization. Second, we use controlled prompt pairs to examine the effects of cue specification, cue combination, and linguistic realization. Third, we assess the reliability of the automated evaluator through comparisons with human judgments and an alternative evaluator backbone.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从三个角度分析 EmoTrace-Bench。 首先，我们从目标情绪生成、强度控制和线索实现三个方面比较了 12 个 T2V 模型。 其次，我们使用受控提示对来研究线索指定、线索组合和语言实现的影响。 最后，我们通过与人机判断以及另一种评估器背骨进行比较，来评估自动化评估器的可靠性。

sents.en: We analyze EmoTrace-Bench from three perspectives.
sents.zh: 我们从三个角度分析 EmoTrace-Bench。

sents.en: First, we compare 12 T2V models in terms of target-emotion generation, intensity control, and cue realization.
sents.zh: 首先，我们从目标情绪生成、强度控制和线索实现三个方面比较了 12 个 T2V 模型。

sents.en: Second, we use controlled prompt pairs to examine the effects of cue specification, cue combination, and linguistic realization.
sents.zh: 其次，我们使用受控提示对来研究线索指定、线索组合和语言实现的影响。

sents.en: Third, we assess the reliability of the automated evaluator through comparisons with human judgments and an alternative evaluator backbone.
sents.zh: 最后，我们通过与人机判断以及另一种评估器背骨进行比较，来评估自动化评估器的可靠性。

paragraphs.en: The 12 models exhibit distinct capability profiles. Target-emotion accuracy ranges from 49.3% to 87.0%, joint emotion-and-intensity accuracy from 29.9% to 55.1%, and conditional Visual 9D expression depth from 62.7% to 83.5%. Paired intensity-control success is substantially lower, ranging from 10.3% to 29.5%. Taken together, these results suggest that models are generally more successful at expressing the target emotion than at reliably controlling its perceived intensity.
paragraphs.zh: 这 12 个模型展现出截然不同的能力特征。 目标情绪识别的准确率在 49.3% 到 87.0% 之间，情绪与强度联合识别的准确率为 29.9% 至 55.1%，而条件视觉 9D 表情深度则介于 62.7% 到 83.5% 之间。 成对的强度控制成功率明显更低，范围在 10.3% 到 29.5% 之间。 综合来看，这些结果表明，模型在表达目标情绪方面的表现通常优于可靠控制其感知强度。

sents.en: The 12 models exhibit distinct capability profiles.
sents.zh: 这 12 个模型展现出截然不同的能力特征。

sents.en: Target-emotion accuracy ranges from 49.3% to 87.0%, joint emotion-and-intensity accuracy from 29.9% to 55.1%, and conditional Visual 9D expression depth from 62.7% to 83.5%.
sents.zh: 目标情绪识别的准确率在 49.3% 到 87.0% 之间，情绪与强度联合识别的准确率为 29.9% 至 55.1%，而条件视觉 9D 表情深度则介于 62.7% 到 83.5% 之间。

sents.zh: 综合来看，这些结果表明，模型在表达目标情绪方面的表现通常优于可靠控制其感知强度。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 (a) summarizes the overall model results. Prompt-level paired bootstrap analysis of target-emotion accuracy (Appendix C ) yields six bootstrap-based groups of models for which no significant within-group differences are detected under the adopted procedure. Seedance-2.5 and Veo-3.1 form the highest-performing group.
paragraphs.zh: 图 3(a) 总结了模型的整体结果。 对目标-情绪准确率进行的提示级配对自助分析（附录 C）得出了六个基于自助法的模型组，在采用的方法下，这些组内均未检测到显著差异。 Seedance-2.5 和 Veo-3.1 构成了性能最高的组别。

sents.zh: 图 3(a) 总结了模型的整体结果。

sents.zh: Seedance-2.5 和 Veo-3.1 构成了性能最高的组别。

paragraphs.en: These differences are not an artifact of generation seed. Regenerating all 448 videos for Kling-3.0 under three generation seeds, with prompts and all other exposed settings fixed, moves target-emotion accuracy by 3.6 points (72.5–76.1%) and joint emotion-and-intensity accuracy by 3.8 points (45.5–49.3%), with no pairwise difference significant under exact McNemar tests (Appendix A.3 ). For this model and these three seed settings, the observed score ranges are approximately 7–11 times smaller than the corresponding cross-model spreads.
paragraphs.zh: 这些差异并非由生成种子所导致。 在三种生成种子下，使用相同的提示词和所有其他公开设置重新生成 Kling-3.0 的全部 448 个视频后，目标情绪准确率提升了 3.6 个百分点（72.5%–76.1%），情绪与强度联合准确率提升了 3.8 个百分点（45.5%–49.3%）；在精确的 McNemar 检验中，任意两种子之间的差异均不显著（附录 A.3）。 对于该模型和这三种种子设置，观测到的分数范围大约是对应跨模型波动范围的 7–11 倍小。

sents.zh: 这些差异并非由生成种子所导致。

paragraphs.en: Performance also varies across emotion categories (Figure 3 (b)). Contentment (85.9%) and amusement (85.3%) achieve the highest average target-emotion accuracy, whereas anger (52.2%) and fear (59.8%) are the lowest. Across the emotion categories included in our benchmark, the four positive emotions achieve 17.7 percentage points higher target-emotion accuracy on average than the four negative emotions, with the difference consistent in direction across all 12 models.
paragraphs.zh: 性能在不同情绪类别间也存在差异（图 3 (b)）。 满足感（85.9%）和愉悦感（85.3%）的平均目标情绪准确率最高，而愤怒（52.2%）和恐惧（59.8%）则最低。 在我们基准测试涵盖的情绪类别中，四种积极情绪的平均目标情绪准确率比四种消极情绪高出 17.7 个百分点，且这一差异在所有 12 个模型中方向一致。

sents.en: Performance also varies across emotion categories (Figure 3 (b)).
sents.zh: 性能在不同情绪类别间也存在差异（图 3 (b)）。

sents.en: Contentment (85.9%) and amusement (85.3%) achieve the highest average target-emotion accuracy, whereas anger (52.2%) and fear (59.8%) are the lowest.
sents.zh: 满足感（85.9%）和愉悦感（85.3%）的平均目标情绪准确率最高，而愤怒（52.2%）和恐惧（59.8%）则最低。

sents.en: Across the emotion categories included in our benchmark, the four positive emotions achieve 17.7 percentage points higher target-emotion accuracy on average than the four negative emotions, with the difference consistent in direction across all 12 models.

paragraphs.en: Intensity control exhibits a different failure pattern. Across models, 17.9%–48.2% of strong–weak pairs receive the same perceived intensity, whereas reversals occur in at most 5.8% of pairs (Table E.3 , Appendix E ). Thus, when intensity control fails, it is much more often because strong and weak prompts produce the same perceived intensity.
paragraphs.zh: 强度控制表现出不同的失效模式。 在不同模型中，17.9%–48.2% 的强-弱提示对具有相同的感知强度，而反向情况最多仅出现在 5.8% 的提示对中（表 E.3，附录 E）。 因此，当强度控制失效时，更常见的原因是强提示和弱提示产生了相同的感知强度。

sents.en: Intensity control exhibits a different failure pattern.
sents.zh: 强度控制表现出不同的失效模式。

sents.en: Across models, 17.9%–48.2% of strong–weak pairs receive the same perceived intensity, whereas reversals occur in at most 5.8% of pairs (Table E.3 , Appendix E ).
sents.zh: 在不同模型中，17.9%–48.2% 的强-弱提示对具有相同的感知强度，而反向情况最多仅出现在 5.8% 的提示对中（表 E.3，附录 E）。

sents.en: Thus, when intensity control fails, it is much more often because strong and weak prompts produce the same perceived intensity.
sents.zh: 因此，当强度控制失效时，更常见的原因是强提示和弱提示产生了相同的感知强度。

paragraphs.en: Cue-level results reveal additional cross-model differences (Figure 4 , left; Table E.1 , Appendix E ). Visual dynamics shows the largest variation across models, followed by event/reaction, sound, and lighting, whereas temporal organization and facial expression vary less. Because human–automated agreement is only moderate for composition and scene/space (Appendix D ), we report these two channels descriptively without further cross-model interpretation.
paragraphs.zh: 提示层结果揭示了模型间的额外差异（图4，左侧；表E.1，附录E）。 视觉动态在不同模型间表现出最大的差异，其次是事件/反应、声音和光照，而时间组织与面部表情则变化较小。 由于人类与自动化系统在构图和场景/空间方面的吻合度仅为中等水平（附录D），因此我们对这两个通道仅进行描述性报告，不作进一步的跨模型解读。

sents.en: Cue-level results reveal additional cross-model differences (Figure 4 , left; Table E.1 , Appendix E ).
sents.zh: 提示层结果揭示了模型间的额外差异（图4，左侧；表E.1，附录E）。

sents.en: Visual dynamics shows the largest variation across models, followed by event/reaction, sound, and lighting, whereas temporal organization and facial expression vary less.
sents.zh: 视觉动态在不同模型间表现出最大的差异，其次是事件/反应、声音和光照，而时间组织与面部表情则变化较小。

paragraphs.en: Overall, target-emotion generation, intensity control, and cue realization capture different aspects of model behavior. These results motivate reporting these dimensions separately rather than collapsing them into a single aggregate score.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，目标情绪生成、强度控制和线索实现分别体现了模型行为的不同方面。 这些结果促使我们应单独报告这些维度，而不是将它们合并为一个单一的汇总分数。

sents.en: Overall, target-emotion generation, intensity control, and cue realization capture different aspects of model behavior.
sents.zh: 总体而言，目标情绪生成、强度控制和线索实现分别体现了模型行为的不同方面。

sents.en: These results motivate reporting these dimensions separately rather than collapsing them into a single aggregate score.
sents.zh: 这些结果促使我们应单独报告这些维度，而不是将它们合并为一个单一的汇总分数。

paragraphs.en: We next examine how model outputs change under controlled prompt variations. The analysis focuses on three factors: explicit cue specification, cue combination, and linguistic realization. Per-model results for all 14 templates are reported in Table E.4 (Appendix E ).
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们将研究在受控提示变化下模型输出如何改变。 该分析重点关注三个因素：明确提示线索的指定、提示线索的组合以及语言实现方式。 全部 14 个模板在各模型上的结果列于表 E.4（附录 E）。

sents.en: We next examine how model outputs change under controlled prompt variations.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们将研究在受控提示变化下模型输出如何改变。

sents.en: The analysis focuses on three factors: explicit cue specification, cue combination, and linguistic realization.
sents.zh: 该分析重点关注三个因素：明确提示线索的指定、提示线索的组合以及语言实现方式。

sents.en: Per-model results for all 14 templates are reported in Table E.4 (Appendix E ).
sents.zh: 全部 14 个模板在各模型上的结果列于表 E.4（附录 E）。

paragraphs.en: Explicitly specifying character reactions produces the largest and most consistent gains. Adding a character reaction to a scene-only prompt improves joint emotion-and-intensity accuracy by 25–59 percentage points across models, with a mean gain of 45 points. Adding a reaction to an event prompt yields a 22–69 point gain, with a mean of 46 points. After Holm correction, these improvements are significant for 9/12 and 7/12 models, respectively. Current models therefore follow explicit facial and bodily reactions more reliably than they infer such reactions from scene or event context alone.
paragraphs.zh: 明确指定角色的反应能带来最大且最稳定的增益。 在仅包含场景的提示中添加角色反应，可使联合情感与强度准确率在不同模型中提升 25–59 个百分点，平均增益为 45 个百分点。 在事件提示中添加反应，可使准确率提升 22–69 个百分点，平均增益为 46 个百分点。 经过 Holm 校正后，这些改进在 12 个模型中分别对 9 个和 7 个模型具有显著性。 因此，当前模型对明确的面部与身体反应的反应更为可靠，而非仅从场景或事件背景中推断此类反应。

sents.zh: 明确指定角色的反应能带来最大且最稳定的增益。

sents.en: Adding a character reaction to a scene-only prompt improves joint emotion-and-intensity accuracy by 25–59 percentage points across models, with a mean gain of 45 points.
sents.zh: 在仅包含场景的提示中添加角色反应，可使联合情感与强度准确率在不同模型中提升 25–59 个百分点，平均增益为 45 个百分点。

sents.zh: 在事件提示中添加反应，可使准确率提升 22–69 个百分点，平均增益为 46 个百分点。

sents.zh: 经过 Holm 校正后，这些改进在 12 个模型中分别对 9 个和 7 个模型具有显著性。

sents.zh: 因此，当前模型对明确的面部与身体反应的反应更为可靠，而非仅从场景或事件背景中推断此类反应。

paragraphs.en: For cues that are not explicitly specified, we still record whether they appear in the generated video. Figure 4 compares overall cue support with support under unspecified conditions. These results characterize cue co-occurrence only and do not support causal interpretation.
paragraphs.zh: 对于未明确说明的提示，我们仍然记录它们是否出现在生成的视频中。 图 4 比较了总体提示支持率与未明确条件下提示的支持率。 这些结果仅描述了提示的共现情况，并不支持因果解释。

sents.en: For cues that are not explicitly specified, we still record whether they appear in the generated video.
sents.zh: 对于未明确说明的提示，我们仍然记录它们是否出现在生成的视频中。

sents.en: Figure 4 compares overall cue support with support under unspecified conditions.
sents.zh: 图 4 比较了总体提示支持率与未明确条件下提示的支持率。

sents.en: These results characterize cue co-occurrence only and do not support causal interpretation.
sents.zh: 这些结果仅描述了提示的共现情况，并不支持因果解释。

paragraphs.en: The benefit of adding a cue depends on which cue is added, not on how many are present. Adding a facial expression to a body-only prompt raises joint emotion-and-intensity accuracy from 40% to 64% on average (+24 points; significant for 2/12 models), whereas adding bodily behavior to a facial-expression prompt adds only 7 points (57% to 64%; significant for no model). Descriptively, facial expression contributes more than bodily behavior in this contrast. Likewise, the template that combines all explicitly writable cues (ALL_DYNAMIC, 64%) performs no better than the face-and-body prompt and only 2 points above the emotion-label baseline (EMO, 62%; Table E.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 添加提示词所带来的益处取决于具体添加了哪种提示词，而非提示词的数量。 在仅包含身体的提示中加入面部表情后，情绪与强度联合识别的准确率平均从 40% 提升至 64%（+24 个百分点；其中 2/12 个模型具有显著性），而在包含面部表情的提示中加入身体行为后，准确率仅提升了 7 个百分点（从 57% 到 64%；没有任何一个模型表现出显著性）。 从描述层面来看，在此对比中，面部表情比身体行为贡献更大。 同样地，结合了所有可明确书写的提示词的模板（ALL_DYNAMIC，64%）表现并不优于“面部与身体”提示，且仅比情绪标签基线（EMO，62%；见表 E.4）高出 2 个百分点。

sents.en: The benefit of adding a cue depends on which cue is added, not on how many are present.
sents.zh: 添加提示词所带来的益处取决于具体添加了哪种提示词，而非提示词的数量。

sents.en: Adding a facial expression to a body-only prompt raises joint emotion-and-intensity accuracy from 40% to 64% on average (+24 points; significant for 2/12 models), whereas adding bodily behavior to a facial-expression prompt adds only 7 points (57% to 64%; significant for no model).
sents.zh: 在仅包含身体的提示中加入面部表情后，情绪与强度联合识别的准确率平均从 40% 提升至 64%（+24 个百分点；其中 2/12 个模型具有显著性），而在包含面部表情的提示中加入身体行为后，准确率仅提升了 7 个百分点（从 57% 到 64%；没有任何一个模型表现出显著性）。

sents.en: Descriptively, facial expression contributes more than bodily behavior in this contrast.
sents.zh: 从描述层面来看，在此对比中，面部表情比身体行为贡献更大。

sents.en: Likewise, the template that combines all explicitly writable cues (ALL_DYNAMIC, 64%) performs no better than the face-and-body prompt and only 2 points above the emotion-label baseline (EMO, 62%; Table E.4 ).
sents.zh: 同样地，结合了所有可明确书写的提示词的模板（ALL_DYNAMIC，64%）表现并不优于“面部与身体”提示，且仅比情绪标签基线（EMO，62%；见表 E.4）高出 2 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Describing a scene by how it feels conveys emotion more effectively than specifying how it should be filmed. With a character present, experiential atmosphere descriptions reach 27% joint emotion-and-intensity accuracy on average, compared with 13% for matched cinematic instructions; 9/12 models favor the experiential form, 2/12 significantly after correction. In empty scenes the two formulations perform alike (38% vs. 37%). For short, single-scene prompts of this kind, experiential language elicited emotional expression more often in our data.
paragraphs.zh: 通过描述场景带来的感受来呈现画面，比具体说明应该如何拍摄更能有效传达情感。 当有角色出现时，体验式氛围描述的平均联合情感与强度准确率达到 27%，而匹配的影视化指令仅为 13%；12 个模型中有 9 个更倾向于体验式表达，经校正后仍有 2 个显著偏好。 在空无一物的场景中，这两种表达方式的表现相当（38% 对比 37%）。 对于这类简短的单场景提示，我们的数据显示，体验式语言更频繁地引发了情感表达。

sents.en: Describing a scene by how it feels conveys emotion more effectively than specifying how it should be filmed.
sents.zh: 通过描述场景带来的感受来呈现画面，比具体说明应该如何拍摄更能有效传达情感。

sents.en: With a character present, experiential atmosphere descriptions reach 27% joint emotion-and-intensity accuracy on average, compared with 13% for matched cinematic instructions; 9/12 models favor the experiential form, 2/12 significantly after correction.
sents.zh: 当有角色出现时，体验式氛围描述的平均联合情感与强度准确率达到 27%，而匹配的影视化指令仅为 13%；12 个模型中有 9 个更倾向于体验式表达，经校正后仍有 2 个显著偏好。

paragraphs.en: We introduce EmoTrace-Bench, a fine-grained diagnostic benchmark for emotion generation in text-to-video models. It evaluates target emotion, perceived intensity, and ten audiovisual cue dimensions using controlled prompts that vary intensity, cue specification, and linguistic realization. Experiments on twelve T2V models show that emotion generation, intensity control, and cue realization are distinct capabilities. Overall, EmoTrace-Bench provides a structured way to localize emotional generation failures to emotion category, intensity, and specific expressive cues, offering a more interpretable basis for evaluating and improving controllable emotional video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 EmoTrace-Bench，这是一个用于文本到视频模型中情绪生成的高精度诊断基准。 它通过控制提示来评估目标情绪、感知强度以及十个视听线索维度，这些提示会变化强度、线索规格和语言实现方式。 对十二个 T2V 模型的实验表明，情绪生成、强度控制和线索实现是三种不同的能力。 总体而言，EmoTrace-Bench 提供了一种结构化的方法，可将情绪生成失败定位到情绪类别、强度和特定的表达性线索上，从而为评估和改进可控的情绪化视频生成提供更可解释的基础。

paragraphs.en: The study evaluates model-generated videos and includes human annotation of 1,120 videos, of which 896 are used for development-set validity analysis and 224 form the test set. The annotation activity underwent a compliance review by the Kling Team and was determined not to require formal review by an institutional review board or independent ethics committee; this determination should not be interpreted as a formal IRB exemption. All annotators were adults who were informed about the task and participated voluntarily. They were compensated, and they could skip content or withdraw from the task. None of the annotators, including the two senior reviewers, are authors of this paper. The submission does not include annotator-level provenance or annotator demographic information. Because the benchmark covers anger, fear, disgust, and sadness, annotators could encounter negatively valenced generated content.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究评估了模型生成的视频，并包含对 1,120 个视频的人工标注，其中 896 个用于开发集的有效性分析，224 个构成测试集。 该标注活动经过了 Kling 团队的合规性审查，并被判定无需机构审查委员会或独立伦理委员会的正式审查；此判定不应被解释为正式的 IRB 豁免。 所有标注者均为成年人，他们了解任务内容并自愿参与。 他们获得了报酬，并且可以选择跳过某些内容或退出任务。 包括两位高级评审员在内，所有标注者均非本论文的作者。 该提交内容未包含标注者级别的来源信息或标注者的人口统计学信息。 由于该基准涵盖了愤怒、恐惧、厌恶和悲伤等情绪，标注者可能会接触到具有负面情感色彩的生成内容。

paragraphs.en: EmoTrace-Bench may have dual-use implications: a diagnostic method for identifying the cues that convey emotion could also be used to make generated media more emotionally persuasive. We therefore recommend that cue-level automated scores not be used as optimization targets without human validation. The benchmark is intended for transparent evaluation and analysis of model behavior rather than for profiling individuals or inferring emotions from real people.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 12 publicly available text-to-video systems (Table A.1 ). Six open-weight systems were run locally from their public releases; the remaining six were accessed through hosted interfaces. MiniMax-H3 and MiniMax-H3-Max (fal) therefore differ in both the checkpoint (H3-Max is a third-party post-trained variant of H3 served by fal) and the inference channel, and the gap between them is not interpreted as a pure model difference. We identify hosted systems by the public product name available at the time of collection and open-weight systems by their public release name. Exact provider-side checkpoint hashes and API revision strings were not exposed consistently and are therefore not used to imply a finer version match than the public names support.

paragraphs.en: To test whether benchmark scores reflect a reproducible model-level capability rather than an idiosyncratic realization from a single generation seed, we generated three complete 448-video batches for Kling-3.0. The model version, resolution, duration, and all other exposed generation parameters were held constant, and only the generation seed was varied across the three batches (labeled A, B, and C below). The native generation pipeline was retained. Expanded prompts were not identical across batches; therefore, this experiment measures end-to-end batch variability. Each video was evaluated once under the frozen protocol; results are reported in Tables A.3 – A.5 . The leaderboard batch of Kling-3.0 was generated under a separate fixed seed and is not pooled into these statistics.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试基准分数反映的是可复现的模型级能力，而非由单个生成种子产生的特例实现，我们为 Kling-3.0 生成了三个完整的 448 视频批次。 模型版本、分辨率、时长以及所有其他公开的生成参数均保持不变，仅在三组批次中变化生成种子（下文标记为 A、B 和 C）。 保留了原生生成流程。 各批次的扩展提示词并不完全相同；因此，该实验衡量的是端到端批次的变异性。 每段视频均按照冻结协议评估一次；结果报告于表 A.3 – A.5 中。 Kling-3.0 的排行榜批次是在另一个固定种子下生成的，并未纳入这些统计数据中。

paragraphs.en: The protocol retains weak, off-target, visually poor, or otherwise unsuccessful generations because these are model outcomes rather than technical failures. Only process failures—for example, an unrecoverable provider error or a file that remains undecodable after retry—are separated from generation quality. Transient network, provider, and decoding failures are retried under the same frozen request settings. A sample that remains invalid is marked unscorable , logged separately, and removed from the relevant denominator; it is never converted into a negative emotion label. Safety refusals and corrupted media are likewise logged as failure types rather than silently replaced by a preferred candidate.
paragraphs.zh: 该协议会保留那些效果较弱、偏离目标、视觉效果不佳或其他方式未能成功的生成结果，因为这些是模型输出的结果，而非技术故障。 只有处理过程中的故障——例如无法恢复的提供商错误，或在重试后仍无法解码的文件——才会与生成质量区分开来。 对于暂时性的网络、提供商和解码故障，系统会在相同的冻结请求设置下重新尝试。 若样本仍然无效，则会被标记为不可评分，单独记录，并从相关分母中移除；它绝不会被转换为负面情感标签。 安全拒绝和损坏的媒体内容同样会被记录为故障类型，而非静默地替换为更优的候选结果。

paragraphs.en: The eight emotions are amusement, excitement, awe, contentment, anger, fear, disgust, and sadness. Each emotion has two fixed scenes. Within a scene, every template is instantiated once at weak intensity and once at strong intensity, giving 224 aligned strong–weak pairs. The scenes are fixed rather than sampled, so the benchmark supports controlled comparisons over these 16 emotion–scene combinations and does not by itself establish scene-level generalization.
paragraphs.zh: 八种情绪分别是：愉悦、兴奋、敬畏、满足、愤怒、恐惧、厌恶和悲伤。 每种情绪都有两个固定的场景。 在每个场景中，每个模板都会以弱强度和强强度各实例化一次，从而生成 224 组对齐的强弱对比对。 这些场景是固定的而非采样的，因此该基准支持在这 16 种情绪与场景的组合上进行受控比较，但本身并未验证场景层面的泛化能力。

sents.en: Each emotion has two fixed scenes.

paragraphs.en: Each record is assembled from a base sentence and zero to five reusable cue segments. The template determines which segments are written, while the intensity member determines the preregistered expressions inside those segments. Table B.1 lists all 14 templates. “Explicit” denotes channels directly specified by the prompt; “implicit” denotes channels left unspecified but still observed in the generated video. An implicit score records cue co-occurrence and does not establish that the unspecified cue arose spontaneously or was caused by another cue.
paragraphs.zh: 每条记录都由一个基础句子和零到五个可重用的提示片段组合而成。 模板决定了哪些片段会被写入，而强度成员则决定了这些片段中预注册的表达式。 表 B.1 列出了全部 14 个模板。“显式”表示由提示直接指定的通道；“隐式”表示未明确指定但在生成的视频中仍然出现的通道。 隐式分数记录了提示的共现情况，但无法确定未指定的提示是自发产生的还是由其他提示引起的。

paragraphs.en: This matrix also defines the limits of attribution: C1, C2, X1, and X2 each have at least one single-channel template, whereas the prompt-side effects of V1–V4 can be attributed only to the four-channel bundle (Table B.1 ), even though their output scores are reported separately.

paragraphs.en: In addition to the 224 within-template intensity pairs, the design contains seven cross-template contrasts, each holding emotion, scene, and target intensity fixed (Table B.3 ). Contrasts 1–6 form the pre-specified family analyzed with exact McNemar tests and Holm correction (Appendix C ); contrast 7 is reported descriptively only (Table E.4 ). The replacement contrasts preserve the set of explicit channels but not text length; they are therefore descriptive comparisons of phrasing rather than isolated causal estimates of wording alone.
paragraphs.zh: 除了模板内的 224 个强度对之外，该设计还包含七个跨模板对比，每个对比均固定了情绪、场景和目标强度（表 B.3）。 对比 1–6 构成了预先指定的检验组，使用精确的 McNemar 检验和 Holm 校正进行分析（附录 C）；对比 7 仅以描述性方式报告（表 E.4）。 替换对比保留了显式通道的集合，但并未保留文本长度；因此，它们是对措辞方式的描述性比较，而非仅针对用词本身的孤立因果估计。

paragraphs.en: The first two examples vary a single intensity-bearing atom. Composite templates change every preregistered intensity-bearing segment included by that template. paragraphs.en: The 12 literal reuse exceptions (Table B.4 ) differ only in pronoun disambiguation and do not alter intensity or cue content. paragraphs.en: Automated evaluation and human annotation share one ordered protocol. First, the rater decides whether the specified target emotion is present. This is a binary verification task, not free classification among the eight emotions. Second, if the target emotion is present, the rater classifies its perceived intensity as weak or strong; if it is absent, intensity is recorded as not_matched rather than forced. Third, the rater independently determines whether each of ten audiovisual channels contains directly observable evidence supporting the target emotion.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化评估与人工标注遵循同一有序协议。 首先，评分者需判断指定的目标情绪是否存在。 这是一项二元验证任务，而非在八种情绪中进行自由分类。 其次，如果目标情绪存在，评分者需将其感知到的强度分为弱或强；如果不存在，则强度记录为“不匹配”，而非强制赋值。 第三，评分者需独立判断十个视听通道中每个通道是否包含直接可观察的证据来支持该目标情绪。

sents.en: Automated evaluation and human annotation share one ordered protocol.
sents.zh: 自动化评估与人工标注遵循同一有序协议。

sents.en: First, the rater decides whether the specified target emotion is present.
sents.zh: 首先，评分者需判断指定的目标情绪是否存在。

sents.en: This is a binary verification task, not free classification among the eight emotions.
sents.zh: 这是一项二元验证任务，而非在八种情绪中进行自由分类。

sents.en: Second, if the target emotion is present, the rater classifies its perceived intensity as weak or strong; if it is absent, intensity is recorded as not_matched rather than forced.
sents.zh: 其次，如果目标情绪存在，评分者需将其感知到的强度分为弱或强；如果不存在，则强度记录为“不匹配”，而非强制赋值。

sents.en: Third, the rater independently determines whether each of ten audiovisual channels contains directly observable evidence supporting the target emotion.
sents.zh: 第三，评分者需独立判断十个视听通道中每个通道是否包含直接可观察的证据来支持该目标情绪。

paragraphs.en: The three outputs answer different questions and are not converted into one another. In particular, target-emotion success and intensity are judged directly, not inferred from the number of positive cue channels. Likewise, a video may contain a local cue related to the target emotion without expressing that emotion clearly at the video level.
paragraphs.zh: 这三个输出回答了不同的问题，并且不会相互转换。 具体来说，目标情绪的成功与否及其强度是直接判断的，而不是根据积极提示通道的数量推断出来的。 同样地，一个视频可能包含与目标情绪相关的局部提示，但在整个视频层面并未明确表达该情绪。

sents.en: The three outputs answer different questions and are not converted into one another.

sents.en: In particular, target-emotion success and intensity are judged directly, not inferred from the number of positive cue channels.
sents.zh: 具体来说，目标情绪的成功与否及其强度是直接判断的，而不是根据积极提示通道的数量推断出来的。

sents.en: Likewise, a video may contain a local cue related to the target emotion without expressing that emotion clearly at the video level.
sents.zh: 同样地，一个视频可能包含与目标情绪相关的局部提示，但在整个视频层面并未明确表达该情绪。

paragraphs.en: A cue channel is labeled 1 only when all five of the following conditions hold:
paragraphs.zh: 仅当以下五个条件全部满足时，提示通道才会被标记为 1：

paragraphs.en: the evidence is directly observable in the video;
paragraphs.zh: 证据可以直接从视频中观察到；

paragraphs.en: the evidence belongs to the channel being judged;
paragraphs.zh: 该证据属于正在被判断的通道；

paragraphs.en: the evidence clearly supports the specified target emotion;
paragraphs.zh: 证据明确支持指定的目标情绪；

paragraphs.en: the evidence is not an ordinary, neutral, or incidental occurrence; and
paragraphs.zh: 该证据并非普通、中立或偶然发生的事件；并且

paragraphs.en: the evidence can stand without borrowing evidence from another channel.
paragraphs.zh: 该证据无需借助其他渠道的证据即可成立。

paragraphs.en: The following cases are explicitly labeled 0: no relevant evidence; evidence that is very weak or very brief; evidence that is occluded or unreadable; ambiguous meaning; a conclusion available only from the hidden prompt; a conclusion requiring an imagined backstory; evidence that depends on another channel; evidence closer to a neutral state; or evidence closer to another emotion.
paragraphs.zh: 以下情况明确标记为 0：无相关证据；证据非常薄弱或极其简略；证据被遮挡或无法辨认；含义模糊；结论仅能从隐藏提示中得出；结论需要依赖虚构的背景故事；证据依赖于其他渠道；证据更接近中立状态；或证据更接近另一种情绪。

paragraphs.en: The modality boundary is part of the rule. C1, C2, V1–V4, X1, X2, and T1 are judged from the picture without using the soundtrack. A1 is judged from the soundtrack without using the picture. A close-up does not by itself satisfy C1, visible movement does not by itself satisfy C2, and a reaction without a visible cause does not satisfy X2. T1 requires the target emotion itself to persist, change, or develop; camera motion, color change, or an event transition alone cannot substitute for emotional development.
paragraphs.zh: 模态边界是规则的一部分。 C1、C2、V1–V4、X1、X2 和 T1 的判断依据是图片，不使用音轨。 A1 的判断依据是音轨，不使用图片。 特写镜头本身不满足 C1，可见的动作本身不满足 C2，而没有可见原因的反应也不满足 X2。 T1 要求目标情绪本身持续、变化或发展；仅靠镜头运动、颜色变化或事件转换无法替代情绪的发展。

paragraphs.en: Emotion-specific rule cards refine these channel-level rules. For example, a sadness–face decision requires a readable facial configuration rather than a single generic cue such as looking down, one tear, or a blue-gray palette. The same visible event can therefore receive different labels for different target emotions, but the shared five-part criterion remains fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 特定情绪的规则卡可以进一步细化这些通道层面的规则。 例如，判断悲伤表情的决策需要可识别的面部特征组合，而不仅仅是单一的一般性线索，比如低头、流一滴泪或蓝灰色调。 因此，同一可见事件可能因目标情绪不同而获得不同的标签，但共用的五个部分的标准仍然保持不变。

Both are blinded to the generation model, full generation prompt, requested intensity, prompt template, explicit/implicit metadata, paired sibling video, and all other ratings. paragraphs.en: Each of the 5,376 videos receives one automated evaluation pass using Gemini 3.1 Pro with temperature 0. Videos are sampled at 8 fps, and the pass consists of two separate calls under the frozen protocol above: the first call returns the target-emotion decision and, when the target is present, its perceived intensity; the second call returns the ten cue-channel judgments. No voting or cross-call aggregation is applied to the 12-model results; the two additional development-set runs (Appendix D ) serve only to verify stability. Because emotion and intensity are returned together within the first call, their separation is procedural rather than an architectural claim that one output cannot influence the other; the cue judgments are produced in a separate call that does not receive the first call’s output.
paragraphs.zh: 5,376 个视频中的每个视频都会使用温度设为 0 的 Gemini 3.1 Pro 进行一次自动化评估。 视频以每秒 8 帧的速率进行采样，该评估流程包括在上述冻结协议下执行的两项独立调用：第一次调用返回目标情绪的判断结果以及（当目标存在时）其感知强度；第二次调用返回十个线索通道的判断结果。 这 12 个模型的结果未采用投票或跨调用聚合方式；另外两次开发集运行（附录 D）仅用于验证结果的稳定性。 由于情绪和强度是在第一次调用中一同返回的，因此它们的分离属于流程上的安排，而非架构层面的断言——即一个输出无法影响另一个输出；线索判断则通过一次独立的调用生成，该调用不会接收第一次调用的输出结果。

paragraphs.en: Uncertainty in target-emotion performance is estimated with 5,000 prompt-level paired bootstrap resamples. The same resampled prompt indices are applied to every model, preserving the matched benchmark design. The six reported Emotion tiers are based on 95% bootstrap intervals for paired differences. Models within a tier are not ordered, and tier assignments on a bootstrap boundary are marked as seed-sensitive.
paragraphs.zh: 目标情绪表现的不确定性是通过 5,000 次提示级配对自助重采样进行估计的。 相同的重采样提示索引应用于每个模型，从而保持匹配的基准设计。 所报告的六个情绪层级是基于配对差异的 95% 自助置信区间确定的。 同一层级内的模型没有顺序之分，且处于自助重采样边界上的层级分配被标记为种子敏感型。

paragraphs.en: Table D.2 summarizes consensus construction. On the development set, first-pass disagreements between the two senior annotators were resolved by the majority of available labels from five trained annotators, and fields without consensus were excluded. On the test set, agreements between the two full-coverage annotators formed the first-pass consensus; disputed fields had no tie-break and were excluded from the first-pass reference. After the automated evaluator was frozen, a second review was conducted: on the development set by the same two senior annotators, on the test set by a third, senior annotator. Fields without a reviewed label are excluded from analyses against the reviewed reference. Reviewers had no access to automated outputs. The test set was generated by a generator not represented in the development set and was not used in protocol development or calibration; it was scored once under the frozen protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 表 D.2 总结了共识构建过程。 在开发集上，两位高级标注员首次标注中的分歧由五名训练有素的标注员提供的多数标签解决，没有达成共识的字段则被排除在外。 在测试集上，两位全覆盖标注员之间的一致意见构成了首次标注的共识；存在争议的字段没有平局裁决机制，因此被排除在首次标注参考之外。 自动化评估器固定后，进行了第二轮审核：开发集由相同的两位高级标注员审核，测试集则由第三位高级标注员审核。 没有经过审核标签的字段被排除在与已审核参考的分析之外。 审核人员无法访问自动化评估的输出结果。 测试集由一个在开发集中未出现的生成器生成，且未用于协议开发或校准；它仅在固定协议下被评分一次。

paragraphs.en: To assess dependence on a single evaluator, we applied the frozen protocol to the 224 test-set videos with an independent Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash backbone (5 fps, temperature 0, high reasoning) and re-ran Gemini 3.1 Pro at a matched 5 fps as a control. Both evaluators used the same videos, rubric, auxiliary summaries, and two-stage structure, with identical rule-file hashes; the only Qwen-specific change was a non-semantic output-format adaptation. Qwen received no human labels, and all 224 videos and their 448 stage calls (two per video) completed without failure. Table D.5 reports agreement with the human reference and Table D.6 the direct agreement between evaluators. Against the reviewed reference, Qwen’s target-emotion κ \kappa is 0.627 (95% CI [ 0.508 , 0.735 ] [0.508,0.735] ) and the Qwen − - Gemini difference is − 0.095 -0.095 (95% CI [ − 0.212 , 0.025 ] [-0.212,0.025] ), so the two are not statistically distinguishable, nor shown equivalent. Qwen’s sound κ \kappa against the reviewed reference is 0.631 (81.5%), and it correctly separated 7 of 8 audio-present versus audio-removed control pairs. Because the pilot covers one generator, it does not constitute a cross-evaluator replication of the 12-model ranking.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估对单一评估者的依赖程度，我们将冻结协议应用于 224 个测试集视频，并使用独立的 Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash 骨干模型（5 fps，温度 0，高推理模式）进行处理，同时以匹配的 5 fps 速率重新运行 Gemini 3.1 Pro 作为对照。 两位评估者均使用了相同的视频、评分标准、辅助摘要和两阶段结构，且规则文件哈希值完全一致；唯一针对 Qwen 的改动是非语义性的输出格式调整。 Qwen 未接收任何人类标注，所有 224 个视频及其 448 次阶段调用（每个视频两次）均成功完成，未出现任何故障。 表 D.5 报告了与人类参考结果的一致性，表 D.6 则报告了两位评估者之间的直接一致性。 在与已审核参考结果的对比中，Qwen 的目标情绪 κ \kappa 为 0.627（95% CI [ 0.508 , 0.735 ] [0.508,0.735]），而 Qwen − - Gemini 的差值为 − 0.095 -0.095（95% CI [ − 0.212 , 0.025 ] [-0.212,0.025]），因此两者在统计上无法区分，也未显示出等效性。 Qwen 在与已审核参考结果的对比中，其声音 κ \kappa 为 0.631（81.5%），并且正确区分了 8 对“存在音频”与“移除音频”的对照样本中的 7 对。 由于该试点仅涉及一个生成器，因此不能构成对 12 模型排名结果的跨评估者重复验证。

paragraphs.en: Table E.3 decomposes the 224 aligned strong–weak prompt pairs per model into four mutually exclusive outcomes. A pair is correctly ordered when the weak member is judged weak and the strong member strong; collapsed when both members receive the same perceived intensity; reversed when the strong member is judged weaker than the weak member; and not comparable when at least one member fails the target emotion. The dominant failure for every model is collapse rather than reversal.
paragraphs.zh: 表 E.3 将每个模型中 224 个对齐的强–弱提示词对分解为四种互斥的结果。 当弱成员被判断为弱，而强成员被判断为强时，该词对顺序正确；当两个成员都被赋予相同的感知强度时，顺序坍缩；当强成员被判断比弱成员更弱时，顺序反转；而当至少一个成员未能达到目标情感时，则无法比较。 每个模型的主要失败模式是顺序坍缩，而非顺序反转。
